birthplace.text: Albert Einstein was born in Ulm, Germany.

introduction.text: Albert Einstein was born on March 14, 1879, in Ulm, Germany.

achievements.text: Einstein is best known for developing the theory of relativity and for his mass-energy equivalence formula E = mc².
He was awarded the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1921 for his explanation of the photoelectric effect.

sightseeing.text: Top Attractions in Ulm include the Ulmer Münster, Fishermen's Quarter, and The Leaning House.
Ulm Minster, Metzgerturm Tower, and the Museum of Bread Culture are notable sights in Ulm.
Top things to do in Ulm include visiting the Ulm Minster, the Rathaus (Ulm Town Hall), and the Wiblingen Abbey.
Popular places to visit in Ulm include Ulm Cathedral, Wiblingen Abbey, and the Blautal Center.
Hidden attractions in Ulm include the Ulm Minster (Ulmer Münster) and the Einstein Fountain.
